scope: Pierre document lifecycle: rendering fidelity, integrity verification, required-field provenance, approval binding

findings_resolved.defect: the WinAnsi PDF font replaced any non-Latin-1 char with '?': Lukasz->?ukasz, Dvorak->Dvo?ak, Nguyen->Nguy?n, CJK->?
findings_resolved.fix: transliterate ONLY out-of-Latin-1 chars to legible Latin while preserving Latin-1 exactly (e-acute, c-cedilla, o-slash); CJK/non-Latin with no Latin form still cannot be drawn by WinAnsi -- the DOCX renderer (Unicode OOXML) is the faithful path and preserves ALL names exactly
findings_resolved.test: src/lib/pierre/v1/__tests__/p16e-f28-name-fidelity.test.ts (11) -- PDF legible, DOCX exact for the full name matrix
findings_resolved.residual_limitation: full-Unicode PDF (CJK glyphs) requires embedding a TrueType font -- a larger change; DOCX is the faithful path today

findings_resolved.defect: verifyDocumentIntegrity compared the version content_hash (for contracts = CANONICAL model hash) against the PDF BYTES sha -- two different hashes -- so it could NEVER return ok:true for a contract-generated version
findings_resolved.fix: compare the file RECORDED sha256 (pierre_rt_files.sha256, set at render) against the recomputed bytes sha256 -- a true file-integrity check; content_hash still returned for reference
findings_resolved.test: src/lib/pierre/v1/__integration__/p16e-f25-document-integrity.itest.ts (2) -- finalized contract ok:true; tampered file bytes ok:false; + p83-files-documents.itest.ts green

findings_resolved.assessment: a template-author-declared fallback on a required variable is a legitimate DEFAULT for INFORMATIONAL documents (weekly-briefing), not Pierre inventing a value. The high-stakes contract/legal path does NOT use this renderer -- it uses contract-readiness (proven in P16E R2). No contract-integrity hole.
findings_resolved.action: left as author-declared default (a forced required-cannot-use-fallback change broke the legitimate weekly-briefing template and was reverted)
